memories.text: Spare front-door key is in the blue tin at Mum's.
Buy pears, washing powder, envelopes. Remember the cloth bags this time.
The dentist suggested a softer toothbrush. Next checkup in August.
Grandad's pancake trick: let the batter rest while the pan heats.
Comprar una maceta más grande para la albahaca. Las raíces ya salen por abajo.
After work I walked home along the canal. Longer, but I arrived in a much better mood.
Library book due Friday; receipt tucked inside the back cover.
First attempt at strawberry jam set like rubber. Try a smaller batch and check it earlier.
Camping list: torch, spare socks, matches in a jar, actual pillows.
La abuela contó que aprendió a nadar a los cuarenta. Me gusta saberlo.
The kitchen tap drips only when the hot handle isn't turned firmly. Photograph the washer before buying a replacement.
Put a banana in my bag before work. The emergency biscuit routine is getting ridiculous.
£18 returned for the duplicate train ticket. Check that it reaches the account.
Rainy Sunday, a detective novel, no radio. A very good combination.
Idea para regalos: recetas familiares escritas a mano, una por tarjeta.
The red scarf needs washing separately. Learned that one the pink-towel way.
Keep next December simpler. Soup, candles, one tray of biscuits. Nobody asked for six desserts.
Old reminder: take lunch to work on Mondays; leftovers otherwise disappear in the fridge.
Eye appointment on the 21st at 10:30. Bring both pairs of glasses.
El limonero tiene dos hojas nuevas. No moverlo otra vez de sitio.
Brother's birthday cake request: chocolate, no fruit hidden inside.
Tried the beginner swimming session. Nobody cared how slowly I went. Go again.
Blue suitcase: 3.2 kg empty. Useful to know before the next flight.
Work ran late, but the lentil soup was already made. Future me appreciates freezer portions.
Llevar monedas al mercado del sábado; el puesto de huevos no acepta tarjeta.
Borrowed a tent from my cousin. Return it dry, with the replacement peg in the side pocket.
Beach day cost almost nothing: bus fare and two ice creams. Pack more water next time.
The hallway bulb takes a small screw fitting. Keep the old box until the new one is fitted.
Bread notes: 500 g flour, 320 ml water, 7 g yeast, 9 g salt. The second loaf was better.
Salí del trabajo con dolor de cabeza. Había pasado toda la tarde sin beber agua.
Finish the library novel before starting another. Apparently six bookmarks do not count as progress.
Aunt said, 'You can be kind and still go home early.' Keeping that.
Paid the annual bicycle insurance. Renewal letter goes in the green folder.
We played cards until midnight. Dad invented a rule halfway through and denied it immediately.
Revisar el botiquín y llevar los medicamentos caducados a la farmacia.
Keep walking shoes beside the door for the evenings after work.
The museum is quietest just after opening. Take a sketchbook next time.
Sister wants herb seeds for her birthday, especially coriander and mint.
Loose tile by the bath. Avoid sealing over the gap until someone checks what's underneath.
Ruta antigua al lago: bajar en la última parada y seguir el camino junto al muro de piedra.
Made hummus with extra lemon and a spoonful of cold water. Finally smooth enough.
A short stretch after work seems to help the stiff shoulders. Set the mat out before leaving.
Train to York booked for 08:40. Seat reservation is in the email, not the ticket attachment.
Found a tiny fossil on the beach. It looks like a button with ambitions.
La vecina tiene una escalera larga y me la presta el domingo. Devolverla antes de cenar.
Cancel the magazine renewal before October. I mostly read the recipes and can borrow it instead.
Piano practice: ten slow minutes were more useful than half an hour of rushing.
Met a friend for soup after work. We talked about everything except the thing we'd planned to discuss.
Winter checklist in one breath: bleed radiators, find gloves, mend coat lining, buy birdseed.
El arroz con leche quedó mejor con la piel de limón entera. Sacarla antes de servir.
This year's best purchase was the reading lamp. No contest.
Put £25 aside each month for the next bicycle repair instead of pretending bicycles never break.
Recipe copied from the paper notebook: roast carrots with cumin, then add orange juice at the end.
Need to leave work on time for the optician Thursday. Appointment card is clipped to the calendar.
Mi sobrino dice que la luna nos sigue porque le caemos bien.
The garden fork is behind the water barrel. Look there before buying another.
First pottery class. My bowl leans noticeably to the left. Still a bowl.
Pack earplugs for the overnight ferry. The engine hum was fine; the corridor doors were not.
Doctor asked me to keep a short record of when the knee hurts. Stairs today, ordinary walking fine.
Antes del trabajo pasé por la panadería. Ese paseo de diez minutos cambió toda la mañana.
Picnic agreed for Sunday, weather permitting. I'm bringing bread, tomatoes and a knife that actually cuts.
The bedroom curtain rail needs new wall plugs. Tightening the screws again hasn't helped.
Read the last chapter twice. The narrator's version of the picnic doesn't match the opening scene.
Sell the unused camera lens only after testing it and finding both caps.
Llamar al abuelo el martes. Prefiere hablar después de su paseo.
Lunch idea for work: chickpeas, roasted peppers, parsley, lemon. Keep the dressing separate.
The felt ornaments took longer than expected. Make fewer next year and give them proper little faces.
Family photo printed surprisingly well at postcard size. Order two more for the grandparents.
Water meter reading photographed today. Last bill was estimated.
La sopa del congelador es de calabaza, no de tomate. Etiquetar mejor.
Try a whole month of borrowing books before buying more shelves.
Work was tiring today. Sat by the river for fifteen minutes before going home, and watched a dog argue with a stick.
Mum's preferred tea is the ordinary loose-leaf blend in the yellow packet.
Sewing machine needle snapped on the thick seam. Buy the correct needles before attempting the jeans again.
Para Lisboa: zapatos cómodos, cargador, copia de la reserva. Dejar espacio para un cuaderno nuevo.
The little café on the steep street had excellent bean stew. I remember the blue door better than the name.
Cycling route past the reservoir has one horrible hill and a very good view.
Forgot the umbrella at work again. Put a spare in the bag instead of trusting the forecast.
Ankle feels fine on level ground. Physio appointment next Wednesday; bring the walking shoes.
La tarta de manzana necesita menos azúcar si las manzanas están maduras.
Transferred £60 to the holiday pot. Small amounts still count.
Quote from my own bad morning: 'A misplaced sock is not a prophecy.'
Door draught strip: measure the width with the door closed. The first strip was too thick.
Going straight from work to the concert Friday. Put the ticket and clean shirt in the same bag.
Este año aprendí a hacer pan y a decir que no sin inventar una excusa larga.
Passport expires next year. Set a reminder well before summer travel.
Gran's button box: the little brass ones came from her winter coat. Keep them together.
Book group meets on the second Thursday now. Bring a question, not an essay.
The washing machine filter contained a coin, two hairpins and something formerly paper.
Después del trabajo fui a nadar. Solo hice ocho largos, pero salí contento.
Buy sunflower seeds for the balcony pots. The short variety, unless I want a jungle again.
My cousin is a nurse at a hospital in Leeds. She says good socks are an underrated birthday present.
Train picnic: boiled eggs were a poor choice for a crowded carriage. Cheese sandwiches next time.
The annual insurance quote went up. Compare the excess as well as the headline price.
El vecino regará las plantas del 12 al 18. Dejar la regadera llena junto a la puerta.
Bring headphones for the journey to work. The quiet carriage is apparently an aspiration.
Mushroom pie worked well with a spoon of mustard in the filling. Write down the pastry quantities next time.
The old desk fits beneath the window if the drawer handles are removed first.
Flu vaccination booked for Saturday morning. Put the appointment slip by the keys.
Idea: grabar a la abuela contando cómo conoció al abuelo. Preguntarle primero si le apetece.
A friend brought oranges instead of flowers. The whole kitchen smells wonderful.
Copied from old diary: stop checking work messages during Sunday breakfast. The toast deserves attention.
Running shoes bought in the sale. Keep the receipt until I've tried them indoors properly.
The library has a seed swap in March. Save some of the spare bean seeds.
Pedir cita para revisar la vista. Las letras pequeñas cansan más por la noche.
Niece wants a birthday treasure hunt. Five clues is probably enough; she's turning six, not applying to be a detective.
Bathroom fan rattles after a minute. Record the sound for the electrician.
Had a proper lunch break at work and read twelve pages. The afternoon felt less crowded.
Camping stove still works. Gas canister nearly empty; replace before leaving.
La playa estaba vacía al amanecer. Encontré una piedra blanca con una raya verde y la dejé allí.
Cold noodle dressing: peanut butter, lime, soy sauce, warm water. Add chilli at the table.
Paid back my sister for the shared train tickets. Reference says 'summer trip'.
Try drawing the same tree once a month. Changes might be easier to notice that way.
Work tomorrow, so pack the swimming bag tonight. Morning enthusiasm cannot be relied upon.
Guardar las fotos del viaje en dos sitios antes de borrar la tarjeta de la cámara.
Found the missing earring inside a boot. No theory adequately explains this.
The secondhand armchair needs a new cushion, but the frame feels solid.
Dad's phrase today: 'Leave room for something you didn't plan.' He meant dessert, but it travels well.
Spent the afternoon sorting photographs. Kept the blurry one where everyone is laughing.
Dejar una taza limpia lista antes de ir al trabajo. Volver y encontrar la cocina recogida ayuda mucho.
Boiler service booked for the 14th, morning slot. Clear the cupboard first.
Reading a book about migration in birds. Apparently the tiny ones make the most astonishing journeys.
Try growing radishes. Supposedly quick enough to satisfy an impatient gardener.
Made a spreadsheet for household bills. The irregular annual payments explain the mysterious expensive months.
Mi hermana prefiere celebrar su cumpleaños con un paseo y una merienda. Reservar el domingo.
A friend called just as I finished work. We walked for an hour without choosing a destination.
Museum ticket includes a return visit within the year. Keep it with the travel receipts.
Waterproof jacket wasn't. Reproof it before the next hiking trip.
Dentist repaired the chipped tooth today. Slightly tender this evening; follow the instructions on the leaflet.
El gazpacho mejora si reposa unas horas. No añadir todo el vinagre de golpe.
Donate the duplicate saucepan and the mugs nobody chooses. Keep the chipped one with the bird for pencils.
Work lunch leaked into the bag. Buy a container with clips on all four sides.
Choir rehearsal moved to Tuesday this week. Pencil the change onto the paper calendar too.
The little lamp flickers with this bulb. Check the bulb specification before assuming the lamp is broken.
Hacer una lista de regalos comprados para no repetir lo del año pasado: tres bufandas para la misma persona.
New tradition worth keeping: a long walk between breakfast and the leftovers.
Emergency fund reached one month's basic expenses. Leave it alone.
Pick up the repaired boots after work on Thursday. Collection receipt is in my wallet.
Bought a small notebook just for recipes that actually succeed.
Llamar más a la familia esta semana. Una conversación corta también cuenta.
The seedlings lean toward the window every day. Rotate the tray after breakfast.
Video call with the grandparents lasted forty minutes. Half of it was a close-up of the ceiling, but we all laughed.
Bread attempt number seven: less flour on the counter, more patience. Good crust at last.
After work, close the laptop and put it away before dinner. Seeing it on the table keeps my mind buzzing.
Hoy reconocí tres pájaros por el canto. O quizá eran dos y uno muy insistente.
Cancelled an unused subscription. £8 a month is £96 a year, which sounds more real.
The balcony tomatoes are tiny and outrageously sweet. Save the seed packet details.
Shoulder appointment by phone on Monday. Write down when the pain started before the call.
Mended the blanket with yellow thread because matching it was impossible. I like the visible repair.
Me cuesta dejar de pensar en el trabajo por la noche. Un paseo sin teléfono ayudó ayer.
Soup exchange with the neighbour: mine was lentil, hers was leek. Return the square container.
Post the cards early. Stamps are in the drawer beneath the scissors.
A small year in distance, a long year in every other measurement. Keep the photographs of ordinary dinners.
Replace the smoke alarm battery. The spare is in the clear box, not the tin marked batteries.
Volví a leer aquel libro de cuentos. El que antes me aburría ahora es mi favorito.
Work felt endless today. Making a proper omelette afterward was oddly reassuring.
New walking route: left at the allotments, footbridge, then the path behind the playing field.
Mum would like copies of the garden photographs. Print them; sending a link isn't the same for her.
The bike pump fits the valve only after turning the little insert around.
Separar un poco de dinero cada mes para arreglos de la casa. Siempre aparece alguno.
First swim in ages. I expected to feel clumsy, and did, but also happy.
Remember the parcel collection after work. The code is in the text message from yesterday.
Two nights by the coast were enough to reset my sense of time. Next visit, stay nearer the station.
Roasted aubergine needs more space on the tray. Crowded pieces steam and sulk.
Mi sobrino empezó a tocar la trompeta. Su entusiasmo es precioso; el volumen también es considerable.
Council collection for the broken chair booked for the 22nd. Put it outside only the evening before.
Idea for a rainy weekend: map all the places I've lived using only remembered rooms.
Put annual leave dates on the family calendar as well as the work calendar.
The repaired boots are comfortable again. Worth fixing.
Frase para recordar: «No hace falta terminarlo todo hoy». Escrita por mí, para mí.
Check bank statements for the small duplicate charge from the grocery delivery.
The fern wants less direct sun. Move it away from the south window.
Booked a hearing check for next month. Bring the list of questions rather than trying to remember them there.
A busy work week makes elaborate dinners unlikely. Buy eggs, spinach, potatoes and something easy to freeze.
La cremallera de la mochila se atasca en la misma esquina. Llevarla a arreglar antes del viaje.
Friend's new flat has no kettle yet. A useful housewarming present has announced itself.
Read a whole novel on the train. Forgot to look out at the sea until the last ten minutes.
Bathroom paint sample looks grey in daylight and lavender at night. Test a larger patch.
Try kayaking again. My arms complained, but the quiet in the middle of the lake was worth it.
Llevé cerezas al trabajo y volví con el recipiente vacío. Comprar más para casa.
Niece's shoe size changes too quickly for surprise purchases. Ask before buying the wellies.
Apple crumble: oats in the topping, walnuts on half. Dad still votes for custard.
The fixed savings account matures in January. Compare options near the date, not every weekend until then.
Five minutes of sketching counts. The mug looked like a bucket today, but I noticed its handle properly.
Revisar las luces de la bicicleta antes de que anochezca. La trasera necesita pilas.
Leave a little gap between work and the family dinner Friday. Arriving rushed makes me bad company for the first half hour.
We used the good plates for leftovers. Should do that more often.
January cupboard inventory: plenty of rice, no cumin, mysterious quantity of cocoa.
Physio said to bring the exercise sheet next visit so we can mark the changes together.
Reservar mesa para el cumpleaños de mamá. Quiere un sitio tranquilo donde podamos oírnos.
The allotment waiting-list email arrived. Reply by Friday to keep my place.
Took the stairs after work instead of rushing for the lift. Discovered the evening light through the high window.
Replace the suitcase wheel before summer. The wobble is no longer charming.
A friend recommended reading poems aloud. Tried one at the kitchen table; the rhythm finally made sense.
El pan de maíz quedó seco. Probar menos tiempo de horno y apuntar la cantidad de leche.
Weekend in Edinburgh: book the quieter train home, and leave a whole afternoon unplanned.
Found a leak beneath the kitchen sink. Plumber coming tomorrow afternoon; cupboard emptied and bowl in place.
Packed yesterday's pasta for work and remembered a fork. A modest but complete success.
Brother paid his share of the cottage booking. Only the cleaning deposit remains to be refunded.
La biblioteca organiza un intercambio de plantas el sábado. Llevar dos esquejes de la planta de la cocina.
Finish the scarf before buying yarn for another project. The basket is beginning to look accusatory.
Dentist appointment moved to 11:15 on the 8th. Cross out the old time everywhere.
Grandad asked for the story about the lost ferry tickets again. He knows the ending and still laughs.
I want one evening each week with no work thoughts and no errands. Start by protecting Wednesday.
Ordenar el cajón de cables. Guardar solo los que sepa para qué sirven, con una etiqueta.
The new porridge ratio is one part oats to two parts milk, plus a splash of water. Pinch of salt matters.
Eye test showed only a small prescription change. Keep the old glasses as a spare.
Visit the bluebells with Mum while they're flowering. Take the shorter path from the car park.
The spare-room window sticks at the bottom corner. Get it checked before repainting the frame.
Después del trabajo compré flores para casa sin ningún motivo especial. Me alegró verlas esta mañana.
Borrowed binoculars made the birdwatching trip completely different. Try another outing before buying a pair.
Travel note: a small backpack was enough for four days. I wore the same jumper anyway.
Set aside the refund for the autumn train trip. It isn't free spending money just because it came back.
Cold cucumber soup needs more dill than I think. Add yoghurt gradually.
Mi amiga se muda el domingo. Llevar cinta adhesiva, bocadillos y una planta pequeña para la ventana nueva.
Work meeting finished early, so I caught the library before closing. A borrowed book felt like a bonus hour.
The repair café can look at the toaster next month. Bring all the loose parts in a bag.
A sentence for the notebook: 'Being a beginner is a place you can stay awhile.'
Vaccination appointment Tuesday at 09:20. Wear something with an easy sleeve.
Preparar menos comida para la cena familiar. Todos quieren repetir el postre, nadie necesita tres entrantes.
The year's nicest surprise was becoming friends with the neighbour downstairs. It began with a borrowed screwdriver.
First work morning of the year: packed lunch, charged phone, forgot gloves. Two out of three practicalities.
Budget review: groceries are steady, little delivery fees are not. Combine orders when possible.
The history book is slow going but worth it. Read one chapter at a time instead of treating it like a race.
Comprar compost y revisar las semillas antes de pedir más. Todavía quedan sobres del año pasado.
Mum's favourite photograph from the party is the one of everyone's shoes under the table.
Annual bicycle service booked. Mention the clicking sound under load, not just 'it makes a noise'.
Going to the cinema after work Friday. Eat something beforehand so popcorn doesn't become dinner again.
The rented cottage had a shelf beside the bath for a book and tea. A small idea worth borrowing for home.
La rodilla molestó después de la caminata larga. Apuntarlo para la próxima cita y llevar la ruta marcada.
Peach salad: ripe peaches, tomatoes, basil, soft cheese. Best eaten immediately, preferably outside.
Back up the family recordings before replacing the phone. Check that the files actually play afterward.
The loose stair tread is fixed. Amazing how much quieter the house feels without that one creak.
A difficult day at work didn't ruin the evening. My nephew showed me his comic, and I forgot the day for twenty minutes.
Devolver el libro de recetas a mi hermana. Copiar primero la sopa de judías y la tarta de pera.
Renew the rail discount card before booking the December trip. Check the expiry rather than trusting my memory.
Gift wrapping supplies already exist in the top cupboard. This note is specifically for the version of me standing in a shop.
A good holiday afternoon: cards, leftover pie, rain against the window. Nobody needed entertaining.
Book the dental checkup before the reminder disappears beneath other messages.
Llevar una libreta pequeña al trabajo para apuntar los recados que se me ocurren y luego olvido.
The savings transfer happens on the 3rd now. Leave enough in the current account for the bills on the 5th.
Started a family recipe booklet. Ask each person for one dish and the story attached to it. Spelling corrections can wait.
New hobby possibility: a weekend bookbinding class. Check whether materials are included before booking.
The kitchen shelf should be 18 cm deep, not 25. Anything deeper will crowd the kettle.
Para el viaje en tren: descargar el billete, llevar agua y salir con tiempo. Siempre agradezco esos diez minutos extra.
Stopped at the park after work and finished the final chapter. Sat there a little longer because I wasn't ready to leave the story.
The tomato chutney needs smaller jars. Once opened, the big one takes forever to finish.
Friend's birthday picnic moved indoors because of rain. We spread the blanket on the sitting-room floor. It still felt like a picnic. Keep this option.
Before work tomorrow: put the recycling out and leave the library returns beside the door.
Hoy encontré una nota de hace años sobre plantar un árbol. Ya tengo sitio para uno pequeño. Preguntar en el vivero cuál irá bien en ese rincón.
